items.title: Generalized Bernstein QSym coaction from universality
items.author: Darij Grinberg
items.source_version: Official author source, last-update 2026-06-12; arXiv:1604.02969 alias (CC0 1.0)
items.difficulty_reason: The author extends the Bernstein construction from the cocommutative case to arbitrary commutative connected graded Hopf algebras over the stated commutative ring, using scalar extension of ABS universality to obtain the algebra/relative-coalgebra map and the second-comultiplication coaction identities. The author explicitly says the map is not fully new and identifies the universality construction as the contribution; that attribution remains verbatim. Cocommutative specialization and antipode corollaries are not extra counts.
